name: rsm
description: Draw vector illustrations with Claude: shapes, paths, text, colours, effects, and export (SVG, PDF, PNG).
long_description: rsm is the vector illustration app of Creative Studio. This extension lets Claude drive it: if rsm is open with its control port (127.0.0.1:7979) Claude draws in the open window, otherwise it runs the engine headless and saves files where you ask.
